title: Spread Social Antibodies Among Friends
coreMove: Help young people create small peer norms that make distraction easier to notice and harder to spread.
sourcePressure: The child section moves into peer norms, showing how practical social antibodies can protect attention in friendship settings.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would moralize about bad friends instead of building practical social resistance together.

hook: Spread Social Antibodies Among Friends as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: teen study group sliding into short-video swaps
exampleSpecs.audience: student who wants a norm without sounding superior
exampleSpecs.stakes: the group loses the exam hour together
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: one student suggests the phrase 'back to the problem' and places phones in the center only during breaks
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A calculus problem sheet sits beside a woven phone tray.

exampleSpecs.audience: trainee group whose boredom spreads through one phone
exampleSpecs.stakes: practice readiness drops when one screen becomes the group's cue
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: they agree that the rescue buoy touching the bench means phones stay in bags until the next drill
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A red rescue buoy rests across a bench slat.

exampleSpecs.domain: theater teens backstage before their entrance
exampleSpecs.audience: cast member protecting group focus without policing
exampleSpecs.stakes: missed cues can cascade through the scene
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, one clip pulls the row; after, they choose a quiet cue card passed down the bench
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A cue card lies beside a rack of costume tags.

exampleSpecs.domain: youth debate team using chat during tournament prep
exampleSpecs.audience: team captain setting norms among peers
exampleSpecs.stakes: argument prep gets fragmented by joke threads
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the team creates a prep-only channel and moves jokes to a post-round thread
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A flow sheet sits under a prep-only channel label.

exampleSpecs.audience: friend group trying to keep filming from becoming endless scrolling
exampleSpecs.stakes: practice ends if clips replace attempts
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: they set a three-clip review ritual, then the filmer returns the camera to the ledge

exampleSpecs.domain: book-club friends after school drifting into gossip feeds
exampleSpecs.audience: teen host wanting a gentle social reset
exampleSpecs.stakes: discussion disappears if feeds become the shared default
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she proposes a first-page ritual where everyone reads one marked line before phones come out
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A page flag sticks from a paperback beside a ceramic phone bowl.
